decisions.reason: The firm has invested in a multi-model product line close to its core and publicly presented it, so management will likely persist due to sunk costs and the need to justify the earlier commitment.
The firm built on its established offer and committed publicly to the hydrocyclone filter, so dropping it would write off the investment and expose the earlier decision as a mistake.
As a product close to the established offer with visible public commitment, the firm has invested enough and is responsible for its outcome, making persistence more likely than withdrawal.
